scope: Single-compartment 11-ionic-channel plus passive closed-loop microcanary. Voltage is recursively generated by a fixed semi-implicit conductance solver; calcium and injected current are imposed. Frozen Task27 ionic models versus the same solver with exact canonical gate formulas.
solver: At each step, first update all 18 gate states using V_t and imposed cai_t over dt. Compute each analytic conductance gbar*panel_multiplier*opening(x_{t+1}), then V_{t+1}=(C/dt*V_t+g_pas*E_pas+sum(g_i*E_i)+I_inj)/(C/dt+g_pas+sum(g_i)), with C/dt=0.001*cm_uf_cm2/dt_ms in mA/cm2/mV. Both arms use identical solver and stimulus. No teacher V fed to autonomous arm.
causal_controls: (1) exact formula gates + fixed solver = internal reference; (2) frozen candidate gate updater at exact reference V with its own recurrent state = teacher-voltage control; (3) frozen candidate gate updater at its own recursive V = autonomous hybrid. Compare candidate voltage errors and gate errors at each horizon, and the teacher-voltage control's one-step voltage discrepancy. No learned voltage solver is claimed.
decision: Technical validity requires finite traces, shared inputs and solver, parent hashes, native passive-only solver calibration and complete arm/seed/episode support. Scientific primary GO requires both frozen both-arm families, every seed, pooled 8ms RMSE <=1mV, worst episode 8ms RMSE <=2mV, no occupancy or physical-voltage violations. All longer horizons and none-arm ablations are diagnostic; do not use them to rescue a failed primary or select models.
limits: Exact-formula internal reference is not an independently validated full active NEURON trace. A positive result establishes only within-contract coupled dynamics for this single-compartment fixed solver with imposed cai and injected current. No CaDynamics, axial coupling, synapses, arbitrary morphologies, end-to-end speedup or Task31 authorization. A mismatch of passive native calibration is technical invalidity, not model NO-GO.
